rows.label: LIKELY
rows.clue: Has a good chance of being the case or of coming about

rows.label: CONSTANCY
rows.clue: The quality of being enduring and free from change or variation

rows.label: POSTERIOR
rows.clue: Located at or near or behind a part or near the end of a structure

rows.label: QUIETNESS
rows.clue: The property of making no sound

rows.label: RADIUS
rows.clue: The length of a line segment between the center and circumference of a circle or sphere

rows.label: PIMPLY
rows.clue: (of complexion) blemished by imperfections of the skin

rows.label: MISERLINESS
rows.clue: Total lack of generosity with money

rows.label: EMBRYONIC
rows.clue: Of an organism prior to birth or hatching
